findings.location: content.body.ruleUk: “Менше за євро — тільки céntimos: ochenta céntimos.”
findings.description: “Тільки” makes the rule falsely exclusive. Amounts below one euro can also be expressed as fractional euros; naming them in céntimos is a useful teaching model, not the only correct possibility.
findings.suggestion: Replace the sentence with “Суми менші за один євро зазвичай називаємо в центах: ochenta céntimos.”

items.reviewerAnswer: For €0.80, both “ochenta céntimos” and “cero coma ochenta euros” express the amount correctly.
items.notes: The listed Spanish price expressions themselves are acceptable.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, “números”, treatment of decimal expressions (from memory).
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, “euro” and “céntimo”, monetary-unit meanings (from memory).

findings.location: task.errors[id=e2].feedbackUk: “Euros — це цілі євро. Менше за євро — céntimos.”
findings.description: The explanation misleadingly restricts euros to whole units. Fractional amounts can also be expressed in euros. The submitted “ochenta euros” is wrong because it denotes €80, not because euros cannot express an amount below one euro.
findings.suggestion: Use “Ochenta euros — це 80 євро. Для 0,80 € тут кажемо ochenta céntimos.”

items.reviewerAnswer: “Ochenta céntimos” or “cero coma ochenta euros”; both express €0.80.
items.notes: The reference answer and the incorrect outcome for “ochenta euros” are correct. The key is not declared closed.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, “números”, treatment of decimal expressions (from memory).

findings.location: task.errors[id=e1]: “Cuesta tres euros el kilo.”, outcome “incorrect”, feedbackUk “Tomates — множина: cuestan.”
findings.description: The reviewed error is an acceptable response: “el kilo” can be the postverbal singular subject. The prompt asks for the price per kilogram and does not require “los tomates” to be the grammatical subject.
findings.suggestion: Accept this construction and remove the error classification, or explicitly require the answer to begin with “Los tomates”.

items.reviewerAnswer: “Los tomates cuestan tres euros el kilo.” Alternatively, “Cuesta tres euros el kilo” expresses the same price with “el kilo” as the subject.
items.notes: This alternative states the same fully specified product price; it does not require a different shopping situation.
sources: Course contract, rule 3: reviewed errors must be wrong answers.
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, “concordancia”, subject–verb agreement (from memory).

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: “Великі літери й знаки в кінці речень не оцінюються.”; task.policy.terminalPunctuation: “optional”; task.accepted contains only variants retaining the period after “euros”.
findings.description: The instruction promises that sentence-final punctuation is not assessed, but the policy permits only an optional final punctuation mark. The first sentence's period is internal to the complete response and remains required by both listed variants.
findings.suggestion: Narrow the instruction to the implemented policy, for example: “Регістр літер і кінцевий знак після всієї відповіді не оцінюються. Крапку між реченнями та знак ¿ збережи.” Alternatively, explicitly accept the promised internal-punctuation variants.

items.reviewerAnswer: “Son cinco euros. ¿En efectivo o con tarjeta?”

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: “Скільки коштує десяток яєць?”; task.prompt[1].text: “Huevos (docena) 2,40 €”; task.options[id=c].outcomes marks “2,40 €.” correct.
findings.description: Ukrainian “десяток” means ten, whereas Spanish “docena” means twelve. The key therefore answers a different quantity from the one requested. The prerequisite gloss “docena — дюжина, десяток (12) (A1-05-L1)” contains the same mistranslation.
findings.suggestion: Ask “Скільки коштує дюжина яєць (12 штук)?” and retain option c. Correct the shared prerequisite gloss to “docena — дюжина (12 штук)”.

items.reviewerAnswer: No option answers the stated question. The label gives €2.40 for twelve eggs; the price of ten eggs is not stated.
